name: native_uccsd_response
scope: Shared unrestricted TensorIR CCSD and standard (T) energies, amplitude and Hamiltonian adjoints, full same-space triples Fock response, and separate exact-reference/fitted-correlation Lagrangians. Native response composition uses the same programs on CPU/CUDA; packed DIIS/Krylov control and MO-to-AO transport remain explicit host consumers, not fully resident CUDA execution. Empty spin outputs skip zero-grid launches while empty scalar reductions still execute.
